body: Let me first start with an introduction that everyone has said in the comments. Yes, the plot of the movie is not original, but that doesn't mean it's not a good adaptation. I am aware that it was copied exactly from the original movie, but it was a nice Turkish adaptation. I must say I enjoyed watching it. I don't think the cast could have been chosen better. It would have been much better if there had been no efforts to make the film look marginal. They added a few scenes that were not in the original movie, but these scenes went against the flow of the subject. It was rated very highly for a movie without an original screenplay. Those who rated the movie did not know that this script was not an original script, while those who commented on the movie tried to defame the movie because it did not have an original script. We are a strange country :D.
I didn't watch the original movie. The characters are not like Turkish. The film is remake, just to make money. But it's a fun movie.

I liked it until i found out that it was a complete rip-off from an italian movie. would've been an 8/10 if the idea was original. the sole reason that i liked the movie was because it was an interesting concept. acting and production wasn't amazing and the plot was a little repetitive.

I watched the original story and I watched more movies for the story, I can compare with them not bad But I watched this movie because I liked the cast and I wondered how is this movie like in cinema Turkish

the movie is not bad for the cast but is the story the sole reason that I liked the movie was because it was an interesting concept.

I would say it is as good as the original Italian version. Keeps you on edge all the time you are watching, characters are very interesting to watch, the final twist -which is different from the original and other remakes- is even better, the acting from most of the cast is great. Especially the young couple's acting is impeccable.

I can't find any con for this movie that is not already a part of the original -the ending-. I wish they changed it.

I see some comments about the characters not acting like Turkish. As a Turkish, I didn't think so. I think some people think all Turkey lives as conservative people with middle eastern culture.
